modalities.evidence: An fMRI dataset for whole-body somatotopic mapping in humans

output.population: A total of 62 healthy adults (34 females), ranging in age between 19 and 29 years
output.summary: Functional MRI of healthy adults moving the toe, ankle, leg, finger, wrist, forearm, upper arm, jaw, lip, tongue and eyes, for whole-body somatotopic mapping; data converted to BIDS and preprocessed.
